formatReferences.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
formatReferences.use: ODA identifies fixed type 0x4D as LWPOLYLINE and describes a modeler body beginning at flags without common entity data. It does not explain the observed trailing bits.

formatReferences.title: ACadRust embedded_entity.rs
formatReferences.use: Routes type 0x4D through the embedded LWPOLYLINE reader; its encoding path writes the type-specific body. Peer implementation only, not semantic or normative evidence.

formatReferences.title: ACadRust object_reader/entities.rs
formatReferences.use: The embedded reader selects raw XY doubles for every vertex; the ordinary AC1027 LWPOLYLINE path selects first-raw/rest-default-delta coordinates. Peer implementation only.

pairedDxf.provenance: Co-located LibreDWG corpus companion; no authenticated AutoCAD/ODA lineage.
pairedDxf.use: Earlier receipt p4-ac1027-sweep-dxf-candidate-field-differential-2026-11-08 establishes that each captured body equals the declared leading group-310 bytes. This pair does not establish producer-wide semantics.

method.candidateProfile: ODA type/body boundary plus ACadRust embedded-LWPOLYLINE field order; raw XY doubles; no common entity prefix or handle stream.
method.measurement: The opt-in test-only source probe has a separate candidate-field decoder that shares dwgBuffer bit primitives with production code. It reads the BS flags, optional BD/3BD values, BL counts, raw 2RD vertices and optional arrays with declared-bit bounds. It reports parsed fields and exact suffix bits; it does not call or publish a DRW entity.
method.probeResult: PASS: drawing read completed with 481/481 published source frames and zero entity/object parse failures; profile and path candidate outputs recorded above.

observations: The candidate order reads the profile prefix through 740 of 744 declared bits and the path prefix through 478 of 480 declared bits.
Profile suffix is four nonzero bits (1100); path suffix is two zero bits (00). Neither suffix is established as padding or as a defined extension.
The temporary exact-span parser rejected both payloads. Experimental production changes were removed; current production retention remains bounded/raw and Partial.

The ACadRust source supports the raw-point field-order candidate, but its parser/source does not provide a source-native exact-consumption proof for these bytes. Its reference-output checks are not an independent geometry oracle.
limitations: No authenticated producer, independent semantic geometry result, complete embedded record decode, DWG-to-DXF output, or native consumer qualification.
No promotion of Sweep, DWG, DXF, ACIS, ACDS, or FreeCAD support claims.
